physicalNotes: Radius 0.07957891 Jupiter radii from Dragomir et al. 2019 (2019ApJ...875L...7D), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019ApJ...875L...7D/abstract): 5,689.3 km at 71,492 km per Jupiter radius. No mass is measured: Dragomir et al. 2019 (2019ApJ...875L...7D), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019ApJ...875L...7D/abstract) gives only an upper limit of 0.01164144 Jupiter masses, so GM is 0, the records' unpublished value. A sphere: no oblateness is measured.

sources.phase: ExoFOP, via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname EXOFOP): transit mid-time 2460980.806574 BJD, taken as BJD_TDB; with its period, the row that predicts 2026-01-01 best (1 sigma 4 min)
sources.orientation: Display convention: transit photometry does not measure the orbit's position angle on the sky, so the ascending node is set at position angle 0 (celestial north).
